name: sanctions-screening-mcp-server
description: Screen names against eleven OFAC, EU, UK, UN, BIS, and State sanctions and export-control lists and resolve legal entities against GLEIF, matched offline over a local SQLite + FTS5 mirror. A screening aid, not a compliance determination.

interface.shortDescription: Screen names against eleven OFAC, EU, UK, UN, BIS, and State sanctions and export-control lists and resolve legal entities against GLEIF, matched offline over a local SQLite + FTS5 mirror. A screening aid, not a compliance determination.
interface.longDescription: Screen names and identifiers against eleven OFAC, EU, UK, UN, BIS, and State sanctions and export-control lists from a keyless local mirror. Resolve legal entities through GLEIF and page through their accounting-consolidation parents and subsidiaries with optional screening. Approximate name matches carry raw Jaro-Winkler similarity, never a confidence percentage. Verify candidates against official agency lists and Federal Register publications; an empty result is not a clearance.
